race.comment: ROADS END (5) was a last start winner (24.50) at this track in a Rank Limit - Grade 5 and will jump from box 5 for the first time. Ran one of the fastest times on the program in his latest win. Can measure up again. ROCK ETERNAL (2) jumped from out wide and was game in defeat last start when a 1.3 lengths second (26.00) behind Whisky Bella at Ballarat. Will give a great sight again. PLAYBACK (1) turned in a fair 4th placed finish last time at Warragul over 460m (26.42). Bold showing expected. BEELINE (8) generally performs well over this distance.
